findings.summary: The chapter says GraphQL is hard to cache but drops the outline's reason (POST to a single URL), so HTTP caching on REST and the GraphQL weakness are never connected.
findings.evidence: "Minus | Over-fetching | Needs HTTP/2, grpc-web | Hard to cache"
findings.fix: Add a line to the GraphQL section: queries go as POST to one URL, so HTTP caches cannot key on URL the way they do for REST GETs.

findings.summary: The REST section packs many separate facts into terse lines, several of which hold more than one idea, with no visual for the verb-to-action mapping.
findings.evidence: "PUT replaces, PATCH changes part, DELETE removes" and "GET, PUT, DELETE yes; POST no"
findings.fix: Replace the verb lines with a small table (Verb | Action | Idempotent | Safe) and keep one idea per bullet.

findings.summary: The GraphQL query code is shown after only the one-line 'Query names exact fields', and the N+1 bullet packs the problem and its fix into one line.
findings.evidence: "N+1: 20 users, 20 order lookups = 1+20 queries; DataLoader batches them into one"
findings.fix: Split into 'N+1: one query per child row (1+20 for 20 users)' and 'DataLoader batches those lookups into one'.

findings.summary: A stray 'Hype' label sits before the closing sentence and the choosing flow is written as arrow text lines.
findings.evidence: "Hype\nNever pick GraphQL or gRPC by hype. Default to REST publicly."
findings.fix: Remove the orphan 'Hype' heading and render the 'Who calls?' decision as one diagram.

findings.summary: The idempotency section repeats the idempotent-methods fact from page 1 and the Retries line is a prose sentence.
findings.evidence: "GET, PUT, DELETE are idempotent; POST is not" and "Same key replays the stored response: a network retry never double-charges."
findings.fix: Present the key flow as a sequence diagram (Client, Server, Retry) and drop the repeated method list or link back to page 1.

findings.summary: The versioning bullet lists three alternatives in one line, and the 'Detail' row of the pagination table is dense with several ideas per cell.
findings.evidence: "Or header Accept: application/vnd.api.v2+json, or query param"; "WHERE id > last ORDER BY id; return next_cursor"
findings.fix: Give each versioning option its own bullet and split the Detail cells into short separate bullets.

findings.summary: The mistake callout holds two ideas in one sentence, and 'Keep the gateway healthy' is an unexplained label over the three bullets.
findings.evidence: "It becomes a single point of failure and a team bottleneck."
findings.fix: Split into two bullets: 'Single point of failure' and 'Team bottleneck'; state the rule under the heading.

findings.summary: The flow uses PKCE and code_verifier without saying what they are or why the verifier is sent, so the learner can't see what PKCE protects against.
findings.evidence: "Auth Code + PKCE: web, SPA, mobile" and "Exchange | code + code_verifier"
findings.fix: Add one line: PKCE means the client creates a random code_verifier and sends its hash (code_challenge) in the redirect, then proves possession with the verifier at exchange. A stolen code is useless without it.

findings.summary: The JWT code appears with only a trailing note, and the mistakes list is unlabeled and mixes mistakes with a fix in one bullet.
findings.evidence: "Long-lived access token: use 5-15 min plus rotating refresh token"
findings.fix: State 'Validate alg, exp, iss, aud' before the code, add a 'Mistakes' label, and split the fix from the mistake.

findings.summary: Mistakes are written as a prose sentence holding two separate mistakes, and the key-choice bullet combines the rule with a caveat.
findings.evidence: "Limiting only in the app: the origin still pays. Retrying at once on 429: use exponential backoff with jitter."
findings.fix: Make each mistake its own bullet with its fix.

findings.summary: The cheat sheet's last section has an orphan 'Over the limit' line and densely packed bullets, and the 'Auth and edge' diagram nodes lack connecting flow.
findings.evidence: "JWT = signed, not encrypted; validate alg, exp, iss, aud"
findings.fix: Split the combined bullets and connect the Client, Gateway, Token bucket and BFF nodes into one labeled flow.
